notes.title: Hope Despair Chaos Release on Nov 8, 2021
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fStMKVg/600x200-summary.png[/img]
[h1]Game Summary[/h1]
A real time social deduction game with Talents ( skills ) combine with Factions (winning condition), real time lightning, flashlight management and hiding in shadow.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1784410?utm_campaign=prerelease_nov8&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=oripost&utm_content=newtrailer_btn style=button]New Trailer just drop, visit Store page now ![/url] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1784410?utm_campaign=prerelease_nov8&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=oripost&utm_content=directlink

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QbGHjkg/600x200-events.png[/img]
[h1]Events starting on Release day[/h1]
[olist]
[*] [b]Hope Coins Daily[/b]: collect Hope Coins and have a chances to get your favorite cloths.
[*] [b]HDC Birthday[/b]: join this yearly event to collect special items, also directly craft special cloth set.
[*] [b]Double Release Clothset #1 and #2[/b]: Both clothset are craftable and available in shop for a limit time. check them out !
[/olist]


[h1]Sneak peek[/h1]
The designs of new Coins and clothsets
[img]https://i.ibb.co/mB3zjSf/600x600-sneakpeak-at-release.png[/img]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/0rHjqnN/600x200-changelogs.png[/img]
[h1]Version 0.2 change logs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve [b]News n Events[/b] panel, 1 click to game news hub.
[*] Improve [b]Bugs n Ideas[/b] panel, 1 click to game disscussion forums.
[*] From this verison, all players have a chance to get a certain amount of [b]Hope Coins[/b] base on their play times. Use Hope Coins to [b]craft chest[/b] and obtain your favorite cloths.
[*] [b]Item library [/b]to track all items in the game from coins to cloths, also crafting and chest opening.
[*] 1 click to [b]Item Shop[/b] available for everyone, go here to directly get the cloth you want, also support the developers.
[*] You only need [b]one copy[/b] of a cloth to wear it on your character in game. Feel free to trade or market your surplus cloths as you want. Most of cloths are [b]tradable, marketable[/b] following Steam policy. 
[/list]


[h1]Playtest Version 0.1[/h1]
Playtest registeration has been discontinued, thanks everyone and don't forget to download new version on the Release day.
